updates.title: Endpoint DLP Adds FTP and SFTP Transfer Monitoring
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP now monitors sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols and can enforce restrictive actions based on organizational policy. This extends DLP protection beyond web and cloud channels to cover traditional file transfer methods, helping admins prevent data exfiltration through legacy protocols.

updates.title: DLP Policy Tips and Email Notifications Now Independently Configurable
updates.summary: SharePoint and OneDrive DLP rules can now decouple policy tips from email notifications, allowing admins to enable either, both, or neither independently. Previously these settings were linked; this flexibility lets organizations tailor user experience and notification strategy per rule.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management Alert Classification Now Available
updates.summary: Authorized analysts can now classify Insider Risk Management alerts as True Positive, Benign (Operational), or False Positive with predefined reasons, replacing the previous dismissal workflow. This granular classification improves alert quality, supports reporting accuracy, and aids policy tuning efforts.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Microsoft Graph API now supports access to Exchange Archive mailboxes (primary and auxiliary), providing a unified archive view as EWS APIs deprecate. This modernizes retention and archive management workflows for compliance officers managing mailbox lifecycle.

updates.title: Auto-Labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report for Information Protection
updates.summary: Admins can now view per-policy coverage reports showing how many files have been labeled or remain unlabeled during auto-labeling enforcement, compared to simulation snapshots. This visibility helps track enforcement progress and identify data drift since the last simulation run.

updates.title: Adaptive Protection Integration with Data Lifecycle Management
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management now integrates with Adaptive Protection to automatically apply retention labels based on users' insider risk levels, dynamically adjusting preservation policies as risk changes over time. This ties data retention directly to behavioral risk assessment for stronger compliance posture.

updates.title: Azure PST Import Migration Method for Data Lifecycle Management
updates.summary: Azure PST Import enables migration of PST files from Azure Blob Storage directly into Exchange Online mailboxes using the standard Exchange Migration Service two-step pattern with analysis and execution phases. This modernizes PST ingestion workflows for large-scale mailbox migrations without on-premises infrastructure.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access Integrates with Purview DLP and Insider Risk
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access now integrates with Purview to enforce DLP policies and detect risky activity at the network layer, protecting data across browsers, apps, APIs, and AI platforms. This prevents sensitive data leakage to untrusted cloud applications by combining network-level access control with compliance controls.

updates.title: Information Barriers Policy Compliance Report
updates.summary: A new compliance report identifies SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint Embedded containers that violate Information Barriers policies after policy changes. This helps admins track compliance drift and remediate non-conforming resources following policy updates.
